questions.question: Before repairing a raised dump box, what must be done first?
options: Support it with approved safety props
questions.explanation: Hydraulic systems can leak down or fail. Raised components must be mechanically supported before work begins.

questions.question: Which tool should be used to tighten a cylinder head bolt to specification?
questions.explanation: A torque wrench applies controlled tightening force. Critical fasteners must be torqued to specification.

questions.question: Why should service information be checked before adjusting valves?
options: Procedures and specifications vary by engine
All engines use the same setting
questions.explanation: Valve lash, engine position, and sequence vary. Manufacturer procedures prevent engine damage.

questions.question: A diesel engine has low compression in one cylinder. Which test helps locate the leakage?
questions.explanation: Leak-down testing shows whether air escapes through valves, rings, or cooling system.

questions.question: Low engine oil pressure with correct oil level may be caused by:
questions.explanation: Oil pressure depends on pump output and internal clearances. Worn parts reduce pressure.
